data.message: Top 3 suitable crop recommendations generated for Rabi season in Hooghly.

reasons: Assured irrigation satisfies the low water requirement (200 - 350 mm) for Mustard / Rapeseed.
Observed mean temperature (15.45°C) falls squarely within optimal range (15.0–25.0°C).
Soil classification 'Alluvial' is optimal for Mustard / Rapeseed root development and drainage.
Standard rotational compatibility with preceding 'Potato'.
Target season 'Rabi' perfectly matches optimal growing window for Mustard / Rapeseed.
environmental_advantages: Thermal conditions (15.45°C) foster robust vegetative development and reproductive timing.
recommendations.water_and_irrigation_considerations: Apply approximately 2 scheduled irrigations during critical physiological stages (200 - 350 mm total demand).
limitations: High vulnerability to mustard aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) during cloudy/foggy spells in January.
Extreme sensitivity to water stagnation; standing water (>24 hrs) causes rapid root asphyxiation.
High temperatures (>32°C) during flowering/siliqua filling induce flower abortion.
agricultural_sources: BCKV All India Coordinated Research Project on Oilseeds (Rapeseed-Mustard)
Department of Agriculture, Govt of West Bengal - Oilseeds Mission Guidelines

reasons: Assured irrigation satisfies the low water requirement (150 - 250 mm) for Lentil / Masoor.
Observed mean temperature (15.45°C) falls squarely within optimal range (14.0–24.0°C).
Soil classification 'Alluvial' is optimal for Lentil / Masoor root development and drainage.
Standard rotational compatibility with preceding 'Potato'.
Target season 'Rabi' perfectly matches optimal growing window for Lentil / Masoor.
environmental_advantages: Thermal conditions (15.45°C) foster robust vegetative development and reproductive timing.
recommendations.water_and_irrigation_considerations: Apply approximately 1 scheduled irrigations during critical physiological stages (150 - 250 mm total demand).
limitations: Weak initial crop canopy allows aggressive weed competition without early hand weeding or pre-emergence herbicide.
Excessive soil moisture or water stagnation promotes fatal collar rot and root rot complexes.
Terminal heat stress (>28-30°C) during February pod filling shortens reproductive duration.
agricultural_sources: ICAR-Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR), Kanpur
BCKV Pulse Research Station, Kalyani - Lentil Production Practices in Bengal
National Food Security Mission (NFSM) Pulses Division, Ministry of Agriculture

reasons: Assured irrigation satisfies the medium water requirement (400 - 600 mm) for Maize (Corn).
Observed temperature (15.45°C) is tolerable, though outside the ideal 18.0–30.0°C window.
Root-zone soil moisture (57.0%) aligns with Maize (Corn) root requirements.
Soil classification 'Alluvial' is optimal for Maize (Corn) root development and drainage.
Standard rotational compatibility with preceding 'Potato'.
Target season 'Rabi' perfectly matches optimal growing window for Maize (Corn).
environmental_advantages: Optimal profile moisture (57.0%) provides favorable sowing bed conditions.
recommendations.water_and_irrigation_considerations: Apply approximately 4 scheduled irrigations during critical physiological stages (400 - 600 mm total demand).
limitations: Vulnerable to invasive pest Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda); requires pheromone traps and early whorl scouting.
Sensitive to soil waterlogging during first 30 days after sowing; requires elevated ridge-and-furrow planting.
Heavy nutrient drain on soil potash and nitrogen; post-harvest soil replenishment required.
agricultural_sources: ICAR-Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR), Ludhiana
BCKV Department of Agronomy - High Yielding Rabi Maize Guide
Cereal Systems Initiative for South Asia (CSISA) - Bengal Hub

data_quality_and_confidence.confidence_notes: Data confidence is High. Satellite observations coverage: 100.0%. Scoring incorporates verified soil, thermal, moisture, and crop rotation rules.

post.summary: Process, Clean & Integrate Agricultural Earth Observation Data
post.description: Executes Phase 5 pipeline: combines farmer profile with NASA POWER, NASA SMAP, and NASA GPM IMERG Earth observation data. Performs sentinel handling (-999 fill values), range sanity cleaning, temporal alignment, rainfall harmonization (double-counting prevention), and computes key agricultural indicators (temperature, rainfall trends, dry spells, soil moisture, and water stress).

post.summary: Process, Clean & Integrate Agricultural Earth Observation Data
post.description: Executes Phase 5 pipeline: combines farmer profile with NASA POWER, NASA SMAP, and NASA GPM IMERG Earth observation data. Performs sentinel handling (-999 fill values), range sanity cleaning, temporal alignment, rainfall harmonization (double-counting prevention), and computes key agricultural indicators (temperature, rainfall trends, dry spells, soil moisture, and water stress).

Executes Phase 6 crop recommendation engine: combines farmer profile inputs (soil type, standing crop, past crop, land area, irrigation status) with Phase 5 cleaned NASA Earth observations (temperature, precipitation trends, dry spells, soil moisture, and humidity). Applies rule-based, explainable scoring validated by ICAR and BCKV to deliver top 3 ranked crop recommendations with full agronomic justification, risks, and rotation constraints.
